one_sentence: This document indexes all formal isomorphisms between physics, theology, and mathematics within the Theophysics Research Initiative.
executive_summary: This document serves as the master index for the Isomorphism Explorer series, listing 38 formal bidirectional mappings between physics, theology, and mathematics. Each isomorphism is designed to be falsifiable and grounded in both domains. The index provides quick links to individual isomorphism records, each with a status (Testing, Candidate, etc.) and a brief title. The document establishes the structural backbone of the initiative, enabling cross-domain research and systematic exploration of the ten laws framework.
